Name: Pitch Adjustment for Flute Blocks
Author: JiangJiangCc
Description:
模组会打开一个长笛块音高菜单，用于直接查看当前音高、更改为需要的音高。

With this mod, you can directly open a menu to select a pitch for the flute block.


[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]使用方法 / How to use[/size]
﻿
﻿将鼠标移动到长笛块上方，然后按下 Ctrl 键（左右 Ctrl 都行），之后会弹出音高菜单，鼠标左键点击选择需要的音高即可。
﻿
﻿注：
﻿ ﻿打开菜单的快捷键可以修改，安装模组后，先启动一次游戏，然后就可以看到模组文件夹内生成了 config.json 文件，打开config.json 文件，修改 "LeftControl, RightControl" 为你想要的按键即可；

﻿------------
﻿
﻿Hover the mouse over the flute block and press the Ctrl key. A pitch menu will then appear, from which you can select the desired pitch.
﻿
﻿Note: You can change the hotkey for opening the menu by replacing the original Ctrl key in the config.json file.
